message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model learns weights that maximize the likelihood of the observed outcomes, and predictions are made by thresholding the estimated probabilities (commonly at 0.5).
